dogecoin.text: In a regular index, one big coin like Dogecoin could make up 40% of your investment. With equal weighting, each coin has the same impact, spreading out your risk.

Major Contributors to the Rally

Dogecoin (DOGE) led the charge with a 106.99% price increase, contributing 45.89% to the overall index performance. 
Shiba Inu (SHIB) wasn't far behind, gaining 55.17% and adding 10.64% to the index.

Dogecoin (DOGE) is the classic cult meme coin with a devoted following. Shiba Inu (SHIB) and PEPE also have strong, active communities. Each has unique narratives, from “joke” origins to the quest for decentralized financial movements.

Unlike regular meme coins, which often have short life cycles, cult meme coins tend to endure. They develop rich histories, milestones, and even folklore, like Dogecoin’s “To the Moon” slogan. The coin’s history is part of its appeal and keeps fans engaged.
